job.title: Enrolled Nurse - Aged Care - Travel Contracts
job.description:
About the Role
MyCare Talent is currently recruiting Travel Enrolled Nurses (ENs/EENs) for aged care facilities across New South Wales.These roles are ideal for nurses who enjoy travelling, gaining experience in different facilities, and earning strong contract rates while supporting communities that need staff the most.

Contracts typically range from 4 to 12 weeks, with potential for extensions depending on facility requirements.

What's on Offer
  • Competitive hourly pay rates
  • Travel support provided
  • Accommodation provided
  • Flexible contract start dates
  • Opportunities across multiple states and facilities
  • Ongoing support from a dedicated healthcare recruitment team
Responsibilities
  • Deliver clinical nursing care under the supervision of a Registered Nurse
  • Administer medications and monitor residents' health in line with care plans
  • Work alongside nurses and the wider care team
  • Maintain clear documentation and care notes
  • Deliver safe, high quality, person-centred care
Requirements
  • Current AHPRA registration
  • Minimum 6 months EN aged care experience
  • Current First Aid & CPR
  • National Police Check
  • Working rights in Australia
  • Willingness to travel for contracts
Locations
We currently have contracts available across regional locations in:
  • New South Wales
  • Victoria
  • Queensland
  • South Australia
  • Tasmania
About MyCare Talent
MyCare Talent partners with aged care providers across Australia, supplying experienced healthcare professionals to facilities where they are needed most. We specialise in connecting carers with rewarding opportunities in both metro and regional communities.

Apply Now
If you're an EN looking for your next travel contract, apply today and a member of the MyCare Talent team will be in touch!

job.title: Care Manager - Aged Care - Travel Opportunities
job.description:
Care Manager | Regional & Remote Aged Care Contracts
Have you worked in travel nursing or management roles before, or thought about taking that step? This is your chance to use your leadership skills in a new setting while supporting regional and remote aged care communities across Australia.
We're seeking experienced Care Managers for short, mid, and long-term aged care contracts across VIC, NSW, SA, and QLD.

You'll receive high agency pay rates, fully paid travel and accommodation, and contracts that fit your availability throughout the year. Each placement is a chance to lead a new team, work in a different setting, and make a real impact in communities where your contribution is highly valued.

Why MyCare Talent?
We build strong, ongoing relationships with our Care Managers and clients, ensuring placements are well-matched and well-supported. Whether you're experienced in travel contracts or trying it for the first time, we keep the process simple and structured straightforward onboarding, consistent support, and responsive communication throughout your assignment.

What's On Offer:
  • Flexible contract lengths and start dates, with options to extend or transfer to other locations
  • Competitive, high agency pay rates
  • Fully paid travel and accommodation
  • The chance to explore regional and remote Australia
  • 24/7 support from our dedicated team
The Opportunity:

Lead experienced, supportive teams delivering high-quality care in unique environments. Broaden your management experience and become part of close-knit teams where your leadership has a real and lasting impact.

What You'll Need:
  • Current AHPRA registration (2027)
  • Experience as a Care Manager in Australian Residential Aged Care
  • Working rights in Australia
  • Up-to-date Covid and Flu vaccinations
  • Valid Police Check & NDIS Workers Clearance
Ready for a new challenge? Apply now or send your resume to anna.rose@mycaretalent.com.au
